mentions.description: Voiden is an open-source API IDE that is being extended with an MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration. The new capability lets AI test APIs and create MCPs, effectively going headless.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building the MCP for Voiden, the API IDE we open sourced a year ago almost. Added the ability to test APIs through AI also create MCP. Basically going headless
